summary: First iteration end-to-end testing of SignalOps AI (backend + frontend). 13/13 backend pytest tests pass. All 7 dashboard pages render with mock data, sidebar navigation, auth gating, incident drawer, and Recharts visualisations work. Sign In redirects to Emergent Auth. No critical issues found.

minor.issue: /api/metrics regenerates incidents independently from /api/incidents, so counts (e.g. critical_incidents=11) do not match the list of 50 incidents returned by /api/incidents. Acceptable for demo mode but worth documenting.
Endpoint calls the external Emergent service and could leak upstream details on failure; current responses are 400/401 which is fine.

issues: Document title is 'Emergent | Fullstack App' instead of 'SignalOps AI' (public/index.html title should be updated for branding).

action_items: (Optional/minor) Make /api/metrics derive from the same dataset as /api/incidents (or persist a generated set) so KPI counts match the incidents list during demo.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py mounts CORS after include_router; FastAPI processes middleware regardless of order but convention is to add middleware before include_router. Functionally OK.
get_user_from_session reads Authorization header without `Bearer ` strict validation — accepts 'Bearer xxx' or raw 'xxx' (after Bearer replace). Minor.
/api/auth/session calls a synchronous http_requests.get inside an async route; should use httpx or run in executor to avoid blocking the event loop under load (works fine for demo).
Mock data: random.choice within get_mock_metrics means responses change every call. Acceptable for demo/auto-refresh, but consumers seeing different counts every 30s is by design.
All MongoDB queries correctly project out _id (good).
Frontend ProtectedRoute correctly uses credentials:'include' and REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (good).
test_credentials: MongoDB-seeded session: user_id='test-user-12345', session_token='test_session_12345', email='test.user.dashboard@example.com'. Bearer header for API, cookie for browser.
seed_data_creation: Re-seeded test user + session in MongoDB 'test_database' (users + user_sessions collections) per /app/memory/test_credentials.md before running tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses mock_data.py (random) - expect KPI numbers to vary per request. Auth: send 'Authorization: Bearer test_session_12345' to backend or set 'session_token' cookie in browser tests on the preview domain. All 7 dashboard pages use data-testid='nav-<kebab-name>' selectors. Incident rows are <tr> elements inside <tbody> on /dashboard/escalations and clicking opens a side drawer with 'Original Escalation', 'AI Analysis', 'Priority Score', 'Recommended Action', 'Timeline' sections.
verified_features: Landing page renders hero, features, how-it-works, CTA
Get Started/Sign In buttons redirect to https://auth.emergentagent.com
/api/incidents returns 50 incidents with all required fields
/api/metrics returns critical_incidents, active_incidents, revenue_at_risk, sla_breach_risk, executive_escalations + trends
Dashboard Executive Overview shows all 5 KPI cards with trend indicators (e.g., +23%, -5%)
Escalation Center shows table of 50 incidents with severity badges
Clicking an incident row opens IncidentDrawer with all detail sections
Analytics page renders 5 Recharts SVGs (pie + line + bar)
Sidebar navigates between all 7 pages and highlights active route
